inherited_decision.decision: Explain launch stages and type/account differences in prose. A generic active card cannot establish the whole launch pattern; no decorative screenshot.

inherited_decision.section: Antes de empezar / Before you start
inherited_decision.decision: An actual readiness/eligibility receipt, if the selected mission exposes one, can separate source signals, channel/permission and handoff prerequisites. Independent Profile/Product/Order fields are aids, not proof of readiness or consent. No receipt fabricated.

inherited_decision.section: Abre la misión / Open the playbook
inherited_decision.decision: Native catalog selection with All/In my plan and type-appropriate destination would show availability; an existing saved singleton identity would explain reuse. Keep both bilingual central states pending; Library prose and unrelated Capture cards do not complete this task.

Capture the actual cards exposed for a safely supported type, keeping identity/context and separating local edits from final save. Prompt/Tone/Upload aids may support distinct cards only after original provenance, current equivalence and pixels are checked. Do not invent all ten cards for one mission.

Incoming automatic/manual choice and outgoing sender/template readiness are different controls. Existing Collector incoming figures only support the first; no substitute outgoing confirmation or delivery.

all_historical_section_debt.heading_en: ## Configure the agent or route logic
all_historical_section_debt.heading_es: ## Configura el agente o la lógica de la ruta

inherited_decision.section: Agente o ruta / Agent or route logic
inherited_decision.decision: Prompt/Intents/Knowledge/Tone/handoff can each answer different configuration questions, while route trigger/graph/Wait/Condition/Assignment need their own native controls. Independent forms do not show a constructed graph, classified intent or real handoff. Keep central route debt pending.

A genuine safe supported Preview/Playground state must be clearly simulated and cannot stand for admission or Inbox outcome. No provider generation, saved response or fixture result produced for a figure. Explain test boundaries in prose until a safe native state exists.

inherited_decision.section: Guarda y habilita / Save and enable
inherited_decision.decision: Central native header Enable/switch, saved state and list Active/Inactive/Disable menu must be bilingual and type-specific. The form submits on toggle; never manufacture activation, saved status or installation. Existing unsaved cards cannot complete these states.

A mission’s own recorded admission/message/delivery/assignment/report receipt would help verify the result, with exact producer/presenter/request/timezone/cohort/units audited first. No unrelated historical campaign KPI or empty Profile is presented as successful launch.

Explain changing one variable and reconciling uncertain writes in prose. Saved/local status can be a useful distinct figure if safely available; no duplicated Prompt decoration or active workflow edit to manufacture it.
Canonical navigation only; preserve all ordered links and avoid repeated support images.
